components.title: Implement ASCII Caesar shift
components.what: Write caesar_shift(s: str, k: int) -> str using k % 26, shifting only characters in ASCII ranges A-Z and a-z, preserving case, and leaving all other characters unchanged.

components.title: Validate visible examples
components.what: Confirm the implementation passes the provided lowercase shift and uppercase wraparound assertions.

components.title: Handle hidden-test edge cases
components.what: Ensure correctness for negative and large k values, empty strings, mixed case, and non-letter characters such as digits, spaces, punctuation, and non-ASCII letters.
